terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A compact Sakura-styled task lamp represented in three orthographic-like views. Radial base and shade are symmetric except for the rear hinge and stem attachment.

reasoning: The overall silhouette is simple, but the head is articulated and requires a true hinge pivot plus child sockets.
Recognition depends on proportional relationships between the thin stem, broad shallow base, tapered shade and small hinge hardware.
Visible seam rings, stepped rims and material boundaries require separate components rather than one fused mesh.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The lamp is a moderate articulated prop: silhouette blockout is easy, while hinge/contact correctness and recognizable stepped construction require a three-level component tree.

details.description: Broad shallow round base has a softened upper shoulder and a darker lower rim.
Pink upper plate meets a darker pink lower ring as a continuous radial seam.
Short pink cylindrical collar sockets the thin off-white stem into the base.
Thin vertical stem carries a narrow controlled highlight, reading as satin painted metal.
Large circular side cap marks the lampshade pitch axis.
Pink rectangular yoke rises behind the shade and overlaps the rear neck.
Lamp shade is a truncated cone, narrower at the rear/top and wider at the luminous mouth.
The wide mouth has a separate narrow cream rim around a warm recessed diffuser.
Off-white shade uses two to three broad toon value planes rather than a flat unlit fill.
Short pink pill/cylinder button protrudes from the narrow shade end.
Warm cream disk recessed inside the mouth becomes luminous when powered.

anatomy.note: Not applicable to an object prop.

definitionOfDone: Keep v1 bounds, ground contact, hinge pivot, top-button pivot and light socket transforms exact.
Read as an exaggerated SAKURA low-poly desk lamp through a broad faceted base, slender stem and oversized tapered shade.
Use stable object-space outline tiers 0.0048, 0.0041 and 0.0033 with 0.18 variation.
Keep all powered light and head motion attached to lamp-light-socket and lamp-head-hinge-pivot.

featureGroups.name: Base, stem and tapered shade proportion
qualityCriteria: Base diameter is approximately 3.0 stem-foot diameters and remains shallow.
Stem is slender and spans over half the total lamp height.
Shade mouth is broader than its rear and does not become a cylinder.
failureModes: shade reads as a bucket or cylinder

featureGroups.name: Articulated hinge and head hierarchy
qualityCriteria: The circular axis cap sits on the visible side of the yoke.
Shade, rim, diffuser and top button are children of one hinge pivot.
A light socket is parented inside the shade mouth.
failureModes: light effect does not follow shade

featureGroups.name: Layered Sakura construction
qualityCriteria: Base lower ring, upper plate, foot collar, stem, hinge yoke, shade shell, front rim and button are separate named parts.
Material zones preserve cream shell, pink accent and warm diffuser separation.
failureModes: all parts fused into one mesh
base and hinge material boundaries disappear

featureGroups.name: Lamp-specific powered animation
qualityCriteria: Diffuser emissive intensity breathes with power.
Hinge performs a small damped nod without altering base or stem.

visualDeltaChecks: total height to base diameter ratio
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge base, stem, hinge and shade into a single mesh.
Do not represent the hinge cap or base rim only with texture.
Do not place the light socket outside the shade pivot hierarchy.
Do not add unseen decorative controls to the base or rear.
Adjacent components must overlap by at least 0.02 world units at shared seams (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Raised or recessed relief and fasteners must be geometry, instanced micro-parts, or displacement; a map alone is an approximation (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
mustNotDo: Do not merge base, stem, hinge and shade into a single mesh.

Do not place the light socket outside the shade pivot hierarchy.

mustMatch: reference-derived PBR material response at or above 0.7 confidence when source pixels are usable
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Base stem hinge and shade proportions
Head pivot socket and button contact
Recessed reflector bulb and diffuser stack

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: No usable GPT Image 2 credential was available. Existing v1 turntable renders are conditionally admitted and are not claimed as generated concept art.
Hidden shade interior remains an explicit procedural approximation.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Stay <= 1.35x v1 triangles and reuse low-segment radial profiles.

proceduralStrategy: Lock exact v1 bounds and frozen pivots first.
Replace high-segment radial profiles with twelve-plane low-poly silhouettes.
Keep reflector, bulb, diffuser and light socket under the frozen head pivot.
Apply stable three-tier outlines after assembly.
Verify one shared powered timeline and exact reset.
risks: Fallback images are existing renders, not new GPT Image 2 concept art.
The large animated light volume is owned by the shared performance system and intentionally excluded from model bounds.
